replace description: Whether to replace these settings from lower-priority packs, or combine them.
suggestion description: Base text style for all suggestions
match description: Style used for matched text in smart suggestions
weak_match description: Style used for matched text in weak suggestions
prefix description: Style used for prefixes (namespaces) in suggestions
repeat description: Style used for alternative matches for a query part that could've matched more than one suggestion part
unexpected description: Style used for unexpected vanilla suggestions
selected description: Base text style for the selected suggestion
background_color description: #AARRGGBB color for the background of the suggestion list
background_selected_color description: #AARRGGBB color for the background of the selected suggestion
ellipsis_color description: #AARRGGBB color for the ellipsis dots above/below the suggestions list when scrolling is possible
